title: Agent Teams
description: The Lead proposes a team for a normal user request, waits for confirmation, then coordinates persistent teammates through runtime-delivered events.

steps.content: Refactor the configuration loader and authentication flow, then update the tests.
steps.annotation: The user describes the goal without designing a team.

steps.content: These areas can be handled in parallel. I propose one teammate for configuration and authentication, and another for tests. Shall I start that team?
steps.annotation: The Lead chooses a small team and makes the extra-agent decision visible.
Teammates start only after explicit confirmation.

steps.content: {"name":"backend","role":"backend engineer","prompt":"Refactor configuration and authentication while preserving interfaces."}
steps.annotation: The first persistent teammate enters WORK with a focused assignment.

steps.content: {"name":"tests","role":"test engineer","prompt":"Update and run tests for the refactor."}
steps.annotation: The second teammate gets an independent slice.
Result and idle state are separate events; the teammate remains available.

steps.content: tests -> Lead: result(test suite passed) -> idle_notification
steps.annotation: The runtime observes mailbox writes and wakes the Lead without a polling tool.

steps.content: Both parts are complete. The interfaces were preserved and the updated tests pass.
steps.annotation: The Lead combines teammate results into one user-facing answer.
A typed request with a request id closes the persistent teammate cleanly.
The matching response resolves the pending protocol request.
